title: VIGIL — Synthetic payment compromise evidence
description: Rehearsal-only evidence dashboard for one synthetic banking-security scenario. Values are fixture observations, not proven loss or production performance.

config.content:
## Evidence before conclusions

Elastic detected a potential login → egress → UPI sequence. VIGIL grounds the lead in raw events and bank context, flags unsupported AI certainty, and stops at a human decision. **Synthetic rehearsal only; no containment or regulator submission is executed.**

data_source.query: FROM logs-vigil-security | WHERE host.name == "pay-svc-prod-01" AND user.name == "svc-payments-admin" AND @timestamp >= TO_DATETIME("2026-09-06T08:30:00Z") AND @timestamp <= TO_DATETIME("2026-09-06T08:45:00Z") AND event.action IN ("login", "connection", "upi_transfer") | STATS evidence_events = COUNT(*)

FROM logs-vigil-security | WHERE host.name == "pay-svc-prod-01" AND user.name == "svc-payments-admin" AND @timestamp >= TO_DATETIME("2026-09-06T08:30:00Z") AND @timestamp <= TO_DATETIME("2026-09-06T08:45:00Z") AND event.action == "upi_transfer" | STATS suspicious_upi_total = SUM(vigil.transaction.amount)

FROM logs-vigil-security | WHERE host.name == "pay-svc-prod-01" AND user.name == "svc-payments-admin" AND @timestamp >= TO_DATETIME("2026-09-06T08:30:00Z") AND @timestamp <= TO_DATETIME("2026-09-06T08:45:00Z") | LOOKUP JOIN vigil-bank-context ON host.name | STATS affected_accounts = MAX(vigil.bank.account_count)

FROM logs-vigil-security | WHERE host.name == "pay-svc-prod-01" AND user.name == "svc-payments-admin" AND event.action IN ("login", "connection", "upi_transfer") | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY event_minute = BUCKET(@timestamp, 16, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | SORT event_minute
